messages:
Priya (AE): Quick one — HealthBridge legal asked for ISO 27001 scope, SOC2 Type II report, and a signed pen-test attestation for the POC by EOD Friday. Also need staging creds for their security team to run tests. Any blockers?
Maya (Sales Eng): We can deliver SOC2 summary and ISO scope PDF. Pen-test attestation requires sec sign-off, usually ~48h. Staging creds — we can generate a time-limited presigned S3 + minimal test account. Who's owning the attestation?
Taylor (Security): @Maya @Priya We can sign the pen-test letter but need their ATO form + primary contact for the red-team. Also confirm whether scans are external-only or internal. Internal network scans require VPC peering / dedicated env.
Jon (Solutions Eng): For POC access, we can create a dedicated tenant on a staging pool, but that may affect pricing. If they want Hosted, we can give a scoped API key + ephemeral creds and dataset. What's expected QPS during the test window?
Priya (AE): They're planning ~50 TPS peak for ~1 hour. Prefer Hosted if that's compliant, but they asked about Dedicated for isolation.
Maya (Sales Eng): 50 TPS is fine on Hosted with a burst policy; Dedicated not required. I'll draft an access recipe we can hand over:

```
role: security-review
duration: 4h
scoped: true
ephemeral: true
```

Taylor (Security): Also, we require a signed NDA before issuing staging creds. @Priya can you confirm legal contact?
Priya (AE): Adding their contact: amanda.lee@healthbridge.com; cc legal@healthbridge.com
audit-bot: New request created in Compliance queue: REQ-8342 — assigned to Taylor.
Maya (Sales Eng): Uploading SOC2 summary + ISO scope to the request: https://internal.redwood/sales/evidence/REQ-8342.pdf (internal link)
Priya (AE): Customer asked if we can provide a pre-signed pen-test letter template they can forward to their vendor.
Taylor (Security): We don't pre-sign attestation letters. We can provide our standard template and will sign after we validate the engagement (or post-assessment). Uploading template now.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Note: if we open VPC peering for internal scans, network ops needs 48h to schedule and whitelist IPs. That could push it to next week.
Priya (AE): They want this week — can we do external-only scans instead to avoid peering?
Taylor (Security): External-only scans + scoped API keys + ephemeral creds + allowlist under our control — doable. I'll prepare an attestation statement that mentions 'external assessment only' so it matches scope.
Maya (Sales Eng): I'll add a billing note in the thread for Dedicated charges if they choose that path; hosted is free for this test window.
Priya (AE): Perfect, thanks. I'll confirm scope with HealthBridge and circle back. :thumbsup:
